description: This source file defines the theme and appearance-related constants and helper functions for the OpenClawChatUI component, supporting both macOS and iOS platforms. It includes color schemes, background styling, and platform-specific appearance adjustments.

methods.name: resolvedAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Returns the NSColor for the assistant bubble depending on the appearance (dark or light mode) on macOS.

methods.name: resolvedOnboardingAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Returns the NSColor for onboarding assistant bubble depending on appearance on macOS.

methods.name: image(_ image:)
